shared_elements: outline border/frame following the edge of the slab and enclosing the field
a prominent vertical shaft or staff-like line on the central axis
a curved/arched element crossing or capping the vertical shaft
schematic linear design filling a single upright panel
justification: Both show a single upright field enclosed by a border line that follows the stone's outline, with a dominant vertical shaft on the central axis crossed by a curved or transverse element — but these are generic compositional features. The depicted content otherwise diverges completely: A shows thin incised linear rows of angular script signs flanking a bare cross/arc device, while B shows a modelled relief motif of a large diamond-lattice-filled rectangular panel above a row of overlapping rounded bosses, with no script and no equivalent of the cross-and-arc.
